text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While shopping at the mall, I saw Mejiro 
Dober and Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: How are the snacks over on your side?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They're all so delicious, it's hard to 
choose... Could I think about it just a 
little longer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's go sample the ones over there 
next!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... It's nothing, really. ...Just a 
gift for an older lady I know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. An older lady I know gave me 
a gift, you see... So I'm looking for a 
return present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I narrowed it down to wanting something 
sweet, but everything looks so 
delicious... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I narrowed it down to wanting something 
sweet, but everything looks so 
delicious... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I can choose teacakes to go with black 
tea in an instant, so... am I just 
indecisive?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It's only natural to agonize over a gift 
for someone precious to you. Especially 
since you're so considerate and kind, 
Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ki... What are you saying, Ryan...! You're 
teasing me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, before that, we need to decide on 
the gift. I'm tasting them all until I'm 
fully satisfied...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I want to say that's none of your 
business, but you totally hit the nail on 
the head...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Y-You might be right... I have been 
eating quite a bit since earlier...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's think flexibly and move away 
from food, maybe? Like general goods, or 
maybe aromatherapy...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's think flexibly and move away 
from food, maybe? Like general goods, or 
maybe aromatherapy...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, I'm all for it. Let's check 
out a bunch of different shops...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having avoided an absurd amount of 
taste-testing, the gift was chosen without 
further incident.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Alright, there's gotta be more sweets 
hidden away that Auntie will love...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"The ones we haven't visited yet are the 
macaron, tart, and traditional Japanese 
sweets shops, right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But I also want to compare it with 
the first thing I ate, so I want to do one 
more lap...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll go with you! We're definitely 
gonna find some good sweets!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while Mejiro Dober did find the 
best sweets, she ended up overeating.
